biography.plain_text: John Anthony Maniscalco is an American businessman who founded and led J.A.M. Distributing, a Houston-based supplier of lubricants, fuel and related products. He built a business serving industrial, automotive and marine customers across Texas, with terminals extending from Dallas to the Gulf Coast. The company became a major distributor of ExxonMobil lubricants.

long_biography.plain_text:
John Maniscalco’s work in petroleum distribution included an early move into marine supply. In 1983, Mobil appointed him its marine consignee for the Port of Houston. His newly formed J.A.M. Marine Company was to store, handle and distribute lubricants, using bulk lubricant storage tanks and a delivery fleet serving marine and offshore customers.

When Ridgemont Equity Partners bought a majority interest in J.A.M. Distributing in 2012, Maniscalco retired from day-to-day management. In choosing the buyer, he emphasised its commitment to the company’s employees, customers and continued growth.
